# Pinned native OpenIDEA icon sources

These unchanged SVGs and icon-name mappings come from the released OpenIDEA v0.1.40 checkout. SOURCE.json records the complete revision, paths, SHA-256 hashes and mapped theme/size variants. Native JetBrains expui and OpenIDEA-authored glyphs are used under their original licensing; see NOTICE.md, LICENSE.txt and original SVG headers. The host’s procedural quote glyph is not represented by its mapped SVG and is excluded.

Regenerate with python3 scripts/build-native-ui-icons.py from the repository root, then synchronize plugin assets. Do not edit source SVGs or generated native-icons.js by hand. Runtime adapters mirror host monochrome/variant handling without changing the pinned source files.
